_note: UAV-A — anchor node. Role 'enb' is a simulator constraint: this node runs the mmWave downlink scheduler and connects to the EPC. Physically it represents a hovering UAV at 60m AGL. z = altitude AGL in metres.

UAV-B — client node. Role 'ue' is a simulator constraint: this node attaches to enb0 and receives scheduled traffic. Physically it represents a peer hovering UAV at 60m AGL, 250m horizontal separation. For other configurations: z in {30, 60, 120}, x in {100, 250, 500, 1000}.
